name: Enmei
source:
The Magician of May / The Distortion Magician

He watches over the MO worlds, maintaining order and trying to solve the mystery behind their creation. He's incredibly pompous because of his ridiculously high intellect, to the point of being too smart for his own good.

Despite all this, he is generally working for humanity's best interests. At first he believed in sacrifice of the few for the sake of the many, but Parilyne and the others will challenge his way of thinking. Despite his knowledge in leadership and the art of war, he highly dislikes betrayal tactics, even if it would get him ahead.

Past his strict exterior, Enmei does have moments where he's sweet and surprisingly chivalrous. He won't bow to just anyone, but will if he's sworn loyalty to you.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/6399818.enmei]official bio[/url]]
